sql: SELECT TOP 1 COUNT(DISTINCT cu.Id) AS userCount, CONCAT(p.StoreCode, @separator, MAX(CASE WHEN (@role IS NULL OR cu.Role <> @role) THEN NULL ELSE cu.Role END), @separator, MAX(CASE WHEN (@market IS NULL OR cu.Market <> @market) THEN NULL ELSE cu.Market END)) AS countScope FROM cso.TblCustom_UserManagement cu INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal p ON p.StoreCode = cu.StoreCode INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetZnodeUser azu ON azu.UserName = cu.UserName AND azu.PortalId = p.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetUsers au ON au.UserName = azu.AspNetZnodeUserId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeUser zu ON zu.AspNetUserId = au.Id WHERE p.StoreCode = @store AND (@role IS NULL OR cu.Role = @role) AND (@market IS NULL OR cu.Market = @market) AND (@isActive IS NULL OR (@isActive = @activeFlag AND ((au.LockoutEnd IS NULL OR au.LockoutEnd <= @now) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT us.UserId FROM dbo.ZnodeUserStatus us WHERE us.UserId = zu.UserId AND (us.PortalId IS NULL OR us.PortalId = p.PortalId) AND us.LockoutEnd > @now))) OR (@isActive <> @activeFlag AND (au.LockoutEnd > @now OR EXISTS (SELECT us.UserId FROM dbo.ZnodeUserStatus us WHERE us.UserId = zu.UserId AND (us.PortalId IS NULL OR us.PortalId = p.PortalId) AND us.LockoutEnd > @now)))) GROUP BY p.StoreCode HAVING (@minUsers IS NULL OR COUNT(DISTINCT cu.Id) >= @minUsers) ORDER BY p.StoreCode
